title: NewTransaction
description: Information for Transaction to be created at PayPlaza

merchant_order_reference.description:
Reference provided by the Merchant for future identification of this Transaction
This field may contain all letters in lowercase and uppercase, digit, underscore '_' and hyphen-minus '-'Usually a unique identifier generated by the Merchant

Amount.description:
Describes how much money the transaction should be.
'value' is a number value with a dot (.) as decimal separator. It should NOT have any digit grouping or thousands separators
'currency' is a 3-letter-code, compliant with ISO 4217

TransactionReference.description: Reference object that represents a unique identifier for a transaction

id.description: Unique identifier that identifies a transaction

TransactionType.description: <dl><dt>PURCHASE</dt><dd>Indicates a purchase where the money will flow from the consumer to the merchant</dd><dt>PRE_AUTH</dt><dd>Indicates a claim on a certain amount of money on the bankaccount of the consumer</dd><dt>REFUND</dt><dd>Indicates a refunds where the money will flow from the merchant back to the consumer</dd></dl>
